system.description:
Beginning at 14th level, you have mastered your ability to enhance and reinforce your Chakra Barrier granting you an additional variation to your Projected Barrier called Heavy Guard.

Heavy Guard. As a reaction, you layer your Chakra Barrier over up to 4 willing creatures within 30 feet of you. Select creatures gain resistance to all damage until the end the current turn. This includes psychic damage.
